name: Arfa Voice Agent

name: Ice Cream POS
shortDescription: Point-of-sale system for ice cream parlours — customer ordering, admin inventory, business purchases, invoicing, and sales reporting in PKR.
description: Ice Cream POS is a full-stack point-of-sale application designed for ice cream shops and dessert parlours. Staff can take customer orders at the counter, track inventory in real time, record business purchases, generate invoices, and review daily and monthly sales reports. The React frontend uses Chakra UI and Redux for a fast checkout experience. The Node.js backend powers a reliable JSON API. Prices are handled in Pakistani Rupees (PKR), making it a practical fit for local retail operations. The project ships with separate frontend and backend folders, ready for deployment on Vercel and Render.

Admin dashboard for inventory and stock management
Business purchase tracking and supplier records
Invoice generation and sales history
Sales reporting with daily and period summaries
Role-based admin login with secure credentials
React + Chakra UI frontend with Node.js JSON API backend
benefits: Replace paper tickets and spreadsheets with one connected system
See what sold, what is low in stock, and what was purchased — in one place

name: Meta Automation CRM
shortDescription: CRM for managing Facebook Pages and Instagram Business accounts — connect once, assign team roles, and post, reply, and track engagement without sharing Meta passwords.
description: Meta Automation CRM gives agencies and in-house marketing teams a secure way to manage Facebook and Instagram from one dashboard. An administrator connects Meta accounts through OAuth, then assigns role-based access so team members can view posts, publish content, reply to comments, and handle direct messages — without ever handing out account passwords. Permissions are granular: View, Post, Reply, and Manage. Page access tokens are encrypted at rest, and every team action is logged for accountability. Built with Next.js 15, TypeScript, Prisma, and the Meta Graph API.

name: Procurement OS
shortDescription: Sourcing and procurement platform for manufacturing deals — lead qualification, supplier research, RFQ generation, quote comparison, and human approval gates in one workflow.
description: Procurement OS is a sourcing platform built for agencies and trading businesses that broker manufacturing deals. It combines a transaction-focused agency model with a licensable software core in a single codebase. The system runs a structured pipeline from buyer request through qualification, product research, supplier outreach, RFQ generation, and quote comparison — with defined human approval gates before contracts, payments, or supplier sign-off. Behavior is configured through YAML files for agents, prompts, workflows, and policies, so operations teams can adjust logic without redeploying code. Structured JSON logs track every entity change and agent run for full auditability.
